items.title: Omar Cooper: Will remain out for Week 12
items.text:
Head coach Aaron Glenn announced Friday that Cooper (ankle) will remain out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Week 12 status still up in the air
items.text:
Head coach Liam Coen said Friday that the team is "not sure yet" whether Tuten (ankle/foot) will be available Sunday against the Titans, Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times-Union reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Parker Washington: Out vs. Titans, considered week-to-week
items.text:
Washington (shoulder) will be out for Sunday's game against the Titans and is considered week-to-week moving forward, Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times-Union reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Downs: Limited to one catch Thursday
items.text:
Downs secured one of four targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.

items.title: DJ Moore: Pair of grabs in Week 12 win
items.text:
Moore hauled in two of six targets for 15 yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
